svg.title: The straddle region of a short interface hugs the unit circle
svg.desc: A centre x with its unit circle drawn dashed in blue. A short segment K of length 0.25 (exaggerated) leaves x to the east. The shaded region Delta(K) is a crescent just outside the circle on the east side and a matching crescent just inside the circle on the west side, each at most 0.25 thick; both thin out toward north and south, where the inner crescent reaches slightly past north and south onto the east side. Every shaded point is within distance 0.25 of the unit circle.

g.text: A short interface casts a thin shadow on the unit circle
K leaves the centre x eastward; L = 0.25 is exaggerated.
Dashed blue: the unit circle around x. Shaded: Δ(K), drawn exactly.
Every shaded point is within L of that circle.
Shrink K and the whole shadow closes in on the circle.
